title: Lost Shtreimel Returned Home
body: A Brooklyn man, Zeus, found a lost shtreimel and tracked down its Chassidishe owner, returning it in an emotional meeting. His search was documented in videos.

title: Peleg Yerushalmi Protests Draft
body: Peleg Yerushalmi faction, associated with Rav Tzvi Friedman, plans a protest in central Israel Monday against the proposed draft law for the chareidi community, promoted in the Knesset's Foreign Affairs and Defense Committee.
